parts.label: Part 2
parts.article:
Welcome once again to the show where we give you travel tips on popular tourist destinations in the Pacific region and today our focus is on beautiful Stanley Island.

Now before we get started, a word of warning, the sea plane service to the island was discontinued last week so for the next month at least, the sole link to the island is provided by the old ferry service since plans to run a hovercraft service to the island have been delayed.

So what is there to see and do on Stanley Island? Well the main tourist areas are on the north, south and east coasts of the island. As far as recreation goes in the south you’ll find several leisure park lands such as Waterworld and Fantasy Island which seem well equipped and reasonably priced. If it’s golf you’re after, the 18 hole course in the south of the island is currently being turned into a conference centre but don’t despair there are two excellent courses just 30 minutes away on the east coast. The south of the island has many large resorts and hotels with plenty of children’s activities and clubs. This part of the island caters mainly for those seeking luxury to medium class accommodation but the east coast has basic apartment complexes with fully equipped kitchens so that at least you can cook for yourself. For those who like to get back to nature you’ll probably find the south coast rather overdeveloped. The rainforest areas on the west coast are largely inaccessible because of the surrounding mountains but those on the north coast are within easy reach and a local agency runs guided tracks through the jungle. If you’re into water sports all of the areas have something to offer.

Before you hear the rest of the program

Now here are a few bits of advice for those visiting the island for the first time to make your stay safer and more enjoyable. The island is generally safe but it’s as well to take a few precautions.

✔ If you’re on any medication bring this with you it may not be available on the island and it’s also a good idea for everyone to pack some insect spray in their luggage.

✔ If you’re thinking of going into the more mountainous region in the west of the island let someone know where you’re going and remember the reception for your mobile phone may be unreliable so don’t depend on that.

✔ Take your own water don’t drink out of rivers

✔ you’re likely to come across lots of monkeys they’re cute but watch out as they can bite.

✔ Finally when you’re back in the more inhabited areas take a break from steak and do try the local seafood it’s fresh and very good value.

analyses.content: 原文明确指出，由于水上飞机停运且气垫船计划推迟，目前通往该岛的**唯一连接（sole link）**是由旧轮渡服务提供的。
Speaker: ...the sole link to the island is provided by the old ferry service since plans to run a hovercraft service to the island have been delayed.
A 选项（hovercraft）被推迟了（delayed），B 选项（plane）上周已停运（discontinued），因此只能选 C。

analyses.content: Speaker: ...but don’t despair there are two excellent courses just 30 minutes away on the east coast.
原文提到 "south of the island" 的球场正在变成会议中心（turned into a conference centre），所以不能选 B。
原文提到南部的球场正在改建，但不要绝望，因为在**东海岸（east coast）**有两个很棒的高尔夫球场。
Speaker: The south of the island has many large resorts and hotels with plenty of children’s activities and clubs.
"Hotels with plenty of children’s activities" 对应题目中的 "family hotels"。
岛的**南部（south）**有许多大型度假村和酒店，并提供大量的儿童活动，非常适合家庭。
Speaker: ...but the east coast has basic apartment complexes with fully equipped kitchens so that at least you can cook for yourself.
"Apartment complexes with fully equipped kitchens" 直接对应题目中的 "self-catering flats"。
**东海岸（east coast）**有配备全套厨房设施的基本公寓大楼，这意味着你可以自己做饭（self-catering）。
Speaker: ...but those on the north coast are within easy reach and a local agency runs guided tracks through the jungle.
原文提到西海岸（west coast）的雨林区域大部分是无法进入的（inaccessible），所以不能选西边。
**北海岸（north coast）**的雨林区域容易到达，并且有当地机构运营穿越丛林的导游路线，即自然徒步。

analyses.content: 给游客的建议是，如果你正在服用任何药物（medication），请随身携带，因为岛上可能买不到。
Speaker: If you’re on any medication bring this with you it may not be available on the island...
"Bring this with you" 指代前面的 "If you’re on any medication"。
Speaker: ...remember the reception for your mobile phone may be unreliable so don’t depend on that.
题目是 "use your..."，原文是 "reception for your..."，指代的是同一物品。
如果你去西部山区，要记住你的**移动电话（mobile phone）**信号可能不可靠，所以不要依赖它。
Speaker: Take your own water don’t drink out of rivers.
"Don’t drink out of rivers" 对应题目 "Don’t drink water from..."。
建议游客自己带水，不要喝**河流（rivers）**里的水。
Speaker: ...you’re likely to come across lots of monkeys they’re cute but watch out as they can bite.
题目是 "Be careful of the..."，原文是 "watch out"（小心），指代的对象是 monkeys。
你可能会遇到很多猴子（monkeys），它们很可爱但要小心，因为它们会咬人。
Speaker: ...take a break from steak and do try the local seafood it’s fresh and very good value.
原文说 "take a break from steak"（别吃牛排了），是要大家去尝试 "local seafood"。
最后建议大家尝试当地的海鲜（seafood），既新鲜又物超所值。
